title: LivechatDiscord
description: Monitor your Minecraft server's live chat directly in Discord — organized by category with smart admin mentions.
body:
![test](https://img1.pic.in.th/images/Screenshot-2026-06-21-214805.png)
# 📡 AdminChat Monitor

> **Keep your whole community connected — monitor chat, get boss alerts, and never miss the action, straight from Discord.**

AdminChat Monitor bridges your server and Discord in real-time. **Admins** can watch all chat activity and staff logs without staying logged in, while **players** get instant boss spawn alerts and announcements right in your community Discord — so everyone stays in the loop, wherever they are.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🐉 Boss Spawn Notifications
Instantly alert **everyone** the moment a **world boss or custom mob spawns**, including:
- 📍 Location & world name
- ⏳ Countdown timer

Perfect for rallying your community — admins **and** players never miss a raid again.

### 💬 Live Chat Relay
Forward **all in-game chat to Discord instantly**, so your community and staff never miss a message.

### 🗂️ Category Channels
Activity is **automatically separated by type** into clean, organized channels:

| Channel | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| **General Chat** | Standard player chat |
| **CSpy** | Command spy logs |
| **LPX** | LuckPerms extended logs |
| **Vulcan** | Anticheat alerts & flags |
| **MSG** | Private message logs |

*...and more!*

### 🔔 Admin Mention System
Automatically **tags admins in Discord** when a player calls for help in-game — support requests never slip through the cracks.

### ⚙️ Fully Configurable
Choose which events to relay, which Discord channels to use, and who gets pinged — all from a simple `config.yml`.

### 🌐 Multi-Server Support
Running a network? **Monitor multiple servers** from a single Discord server using separate channel categories per node.

### ⚡ Lightweight & Async
All Discord webhooks are sent **asynchronously**, so your server **TPS stays unaffected**.

### 🔒 Permission-Based Access
Restrict sensitive logs (**CSpy, LPX, MSG**) to specific Discord roles — keeping private data away from regular staff.

---

## 🎯 Use Cases

### 👥 For Players & Community
- **🐲 Boss Events** — Get pinged the moment a raid boss or world boss spawns, with location & countdown
- **📢 Stay Connected** — Follow server chat and announcements even when you're not online

### 🛡️ For Admins & Staff
- **Moderation** — Catch rule-breakers in chat without being online
- **Staff Oversight** — Monitor command usage and permission changes in real-time
- **Player Support** — Never miss a `/helpop` or support request again

---

> ### Ready to bring your server and community closer?
> **Install AdminChat Monitor and keep everyone in the loop — from anywhere.**
